newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE CEN BANK WARNS ON UNLICENSED FUND MANAGERS.
newsitem.headline: UAE CEN BANK WARNS ON UNLICENSED FUND MANAGERS.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates Central Bank has warned against dealing with fund managers and foreign exchange dealers which are not licensed by the Bank.

"We have noticed recently that some establishments and companies are promoting funds-taking for management and foreign exchange dealings although these entities are not licensed by the Central Bank," it said in a statement.
As dealings with unlicensed parties could put at risk funds placed with them, the Bank urged the public to ask companies for proof of their licence or to check with the Central Bank.
In the past few years the Bank has introduced various new laws tightening regulation of the financial sector.
